finance.caption: 3 budgeting mistakes I made in my 20s 💸 #personalfinance #budgeting #moneytips
finance.transcript: Okay, three budgeting mistakes I made in my twenties. Number one, I didn't track small purchases. Five dollar coffees add up to over a hundred a month. Number two, I paid overdraft fees because I never set up low balance alerts. Number three, I had no emergency fund, so every surprise went on a credit card. Start with a thousand dollar buffer.
